invariants.rationale: instantTime is passed to commitInternal and likely must not be null for a commit operation.
partitionPath is used as a key in singletonMap, so it should not be null.
records is used as a value in a map passed to commitInternal; a null records value is likely invalid.
indexParser is an explicit parameter expected to be non-null for metadata operations.
singletonMap always produces a map of size 1; the contract is preserved at this point.
